title: LangChain Core Utilities
summary: This module centralizes fundamental utilities for API lifecycle management, security, callback handling, chat history, data serialization, and system information, providing essential building blocks for the LangChain ecosystem.

nodes.label: General Base Utilities
nodes.title: General Base Utilities
nodes.description: Provides fundamental utilities for caching, object serialization, system information, iterable manipulation, HTML parsing, and Pydantic enhancements.

nodes.label: API Lifecycle Management
nodes.title: API Lifecycle Management
nodes.description: Manages API stability and informs users about changes, including beta features and deprecations.

nodes.label: Security & URL Validation
nodes.title: Security & URL Validation
nodes.description: Provides URL validation against SSRF policies and creates SSRF-safe HTTP clients to prevent unauthorized access.

nodes.label: Callbacks & Chat History
nodes.title: Callbacks & Chat History
nodes.description: Offers asynchronous callbacks, execution tracing, custom event dispatching, LLM usage tracking, and in-memory chat history storage.

groups.label: Security Features
